description: Season-peak production fits (2026-10-14): artificial_lookback8 from season-peak-short-reporting, the best peak-week recipe of the season-peak search (experiments/season-peak-ensemble-tree/protocol.json: peak-week log score 2.81, peak-size log WIS 0.306 on 862 matched state/DC tasks in 2024-25 and 2025-26, FluSight-ensemble 2.58 and 0.52). Sampled MLP, square-root counts, local noise, neighbouring-state exchange, multiscale shape features, 8-week history; training admission and ED histories perturbed by synchronous_phase_log reporting errors. Labels: 36 future finalized weekly flu admissions and ED share. Retrained on all four completed seasons 2022-23..2025-26 (no held-out season), seeds 42-49. Operational inputs: raw reported Wednesday data (forecast_view=raw).
